quests.instruction: Touch the shape that matches a slice of cheesy pizza or small clothes hanger!
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: It looks like a perfect triangle!
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: A triangle has three points, just like a yummy slice of pizza!

quests.instruction: Touch the shape that matches a flat entry door or wide classroom writing board!
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: It looks like a perfect rectangle!
quests.explanation: Take your time and look closely. You'll get it right next time!
quests.funFact: A rectangle has two long sides and two short sides, like a tall door!

quests.funFact: A square has four equal sides, just like a perfect cardboard gift box!
